title: “Small design flaws can lead to big waste,” Dhruvi Thakkar, Sleeve Office
summary: Dhruvi Thakkar is the Founder and Lead Packaging Designer at Sleeve Office, a London-based packaging design agency, which was established in November 2025. She was selected for the Future Leaders Class of 2027 by Paris Packaging Week. What made you choose packaging as a career, and what inspires you about the sector? Dhruvi Thakkar - My packaging story began long before I became a designer. Growing up around my family's manufacturing business in India, I spent time on the factory floor,... - Packaging & design
